text: Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued January 17, 2023, Appeal DDRT2023-19.

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Confirmed the determination of a dangerous dog and directed that the conditions of the Order remain in effect, and that the Tribunal forward the reasons for this decision to Veronika Taratine and the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards on or before July 4, 2023.
